profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Palantir | Backend Development | Platform
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer specializing in platform development, backend systems, and site reliability engineering. Proven track record in enhancing microservice development, automating deployment processes, and improving system reliability and performance. Skilled in a wide range of programming languages and technologies, including Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust(Intermediate), Kubernetes and Cloud Native Technologies. Passionate about leveraging technology to solve complex problems and drive efficiency.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York City Metropolitan Area · Hybrid
positions.description: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Platform Development · Github App · Agentic AI Development

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
● Developed a platform of shared services, libraries, and patterns, abstracting authentication(OAuth 2.0), event-driven architecture, Kubernetes, and automated testing to enhance microservice development and increase developer productivity
● Designed and assisted in the implementation of a scalable, custom Pub/Sub system using TypeScript and MongoDB, featuring partitioned and filtered event streams for enhanced performance, which is now used by all microservices
● Automated Kubernetes Helm Deployments using Argo and a custom GitOps CI/CD service, slashing deployment times by 95%
● Developed features for a Backstage based developer portal, such as auditing deployments allowing devs and product owners to see exactly when each service was changed and to compare differences
● Architected and developed a custom tracing, metrics, logging, and profiling library using OpenTelemetry, significantly improving observability and troubleshooting capabilities
● Researched and Implemented Kubernetes pod autoscaling using custom metrics from Prometheus, enabling dynamic scaling of pods in response to workload fluctuations
● Participated in a one month Production on-call rotation with the SRE team to troubleshoot issues across the entire stack
positions.insights: Skills: Distributed Systems · Kubernetes · Microservices · Platform Architecture · MongoDB · Node.js · Platform Development · Software Development · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Software Design · Software Infrastructure

positions.title: Software Engineer - Backend
positions.description: Used tools and technologies such as Nodejs, Rust, Scylla, Postgres, Marathon, RabbitMQ, Redis, etc to help serve billions of monthly requests

positions.title: DevOps Engineer
positions.description:
Used tools and technologies such as Chef, Python, Marathon/Mesos, K8s, Jenkins, etc to ensure services are up and running and keep developer productivity high
Assisted with mainly on prem data center infrastructure installation and configuration

positions.title: Enterprise Architect
positions.description:
Enterprise Architect for External Identity Access and Management
Developed a mock website using NodeJS and React to showcase IAM capabilities to stakeholders

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description:
Developed fully automated CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, Chef, and AWS to transition the team towards DevOps delivery
Served as a Scrum Master to transform the team from waterfall to agile delivery allowing for greater productivity
Created various ServiceNow and Tableau Dashboards to monitor support ticket statistics allowing the prioritization of tasks
Worked with development team to troubleshoot production system errors to ensure service level agreements are not breached
Lead a proof of concept to demonstrate how to containerize applications using Docker on AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service
Provided architectural and technical guidance to development teams to improve resiliency, efficiency, performance, and costs
Automated the pull of service request data from ServiceNow using Python in order to do trend analysis and visualization
Actively managed, improved, and monitored AWS EC2, EBS, RDS, S3, and CloudFront, including backups and upgrades 
Established a Training Curriculum which allowed team members to quickly get up to speed with SRE Principles and practices

positions.title: Janssen Advanced Computing Co-Op
positions.description:
Implemented an interface to Oracle Databases on RStudio Shiny Servers allowing users to run SQL commands in RStudio
Developed a chat bot using RASA on AWS EC2 to assist users on RStudio Shiny Servers with mundane questions and requests
Automated RStudio Package Manager on AWS EC2 with Chef to create a seamless experience with package installations
Assisted in a blockchain proof of concept to lessen the time of patient recruitment and reduce replication in R&D studies
Created a high performance computing cluster on AWS and Cyclecloud to decrease MATLAB execution time for users

positions.title: Tennis Instructor
positions.description: Help kids under 10 years old in a day care program learn the fundamentals of tennis while still having fun

volunteerExperiences.description: Helped Organized Sanskaar Charity Cup. This tennis tournament raised over $4,000 for Bhutanese Refugees
